name: Krannert Building
scope: Krannert-only facade refinement and source assessment. Master, manifest, README, shared indexes, placement marker, and other building assets were not edited.

sources.provider: Indiana Architect / Indiana Society of Architects
sources.title: Indiana Architect, October 1965, selected-for-exhibition project page
sources.limits: Perspective historic photo, not a dimensioned or color-calibrated elevation; no evidence for hidden courtyard/re-entrant faces, exact bay dimensions, or current facade condition.

sources.title: Krannert Building exterior photograph
sources.limits: Capture date and camera calibration are not provided; qualitative facade cues only.

changes: Rebuilt the four windowed-facade mesh objects with pale full-height piers centered on bay boundaries rather than centered over glazing.
Changed each bay to a centered narrow vertical glazing slot, capped at an estimated 1.25 m width, with a 0.28 m opaque sill/spandrel and fine 0.045 m head/sill/transom bars.

Applied the same construction consistently to the existing windowed facade segments. The source-photo comparison supports the vertical-slot / broad-pier reading; the specified dimensions are visual estimates, not surveyed values.

visual_evidence.render_method: Blender 5.2.3 reopened the saved source asset and rendered the south-front and two oblique world-space views. Temporary render ground, cameras and render environment were not saved into the building asset.

sources_reviewed.provider: Purdue Daniels School Safety and Facilities
sources_reviewed.title: Krannert Building Emergency Maps
sources_reviewed.coverage: Basement, ground floor and floors 1-7; room labels, partitions in diagrammatic form, circulation, stairs and elevators.
sources_reviewed.limit: No scale, dimensions, issue date or as-built status; supports adjacency/topology only, not measured partition coordinates.

sources_reviewed.title: Krannert Building MEL Renovation Phase III, Second Floor Furniture Plan
sources_reviewed.limit: The sheet explicitly says NOT TO SCALE; furniture plan and proposed/renovation scope do not establish current as-built geometry.

sources_reviewed.title: Self-guided tour
sources_reviewed.limit: Interior photographs support room identity, finishes and furniture types only; no dimensioned plans or coordinates.

interior_courtyard_geometry_source_audit.decision: No new interior partitions, room dimensions, courtyard volumes or seam edits were made. Available plans are diagrammatic/not-to-scale and do not support dimensionally registering new interior geometry to the model without an unverified scale, orientation or as-built assumption. Existing furnished Drawing Room and Parrish Library interiors remain in place; other interior/courtyard layout remains uncertain.
interior_courtyard_geometry_source_audit.next_evidence_needed: A dimensioned/as-built floor plan with scale and orientation, or a sufficiently complete set of interior photos with reliable location/level information, is needed to register and revise whole-floor partitions and circulation.

independent_grade_status: Awaiting a fresh independent full-building review; no self-score assigned.
